answer: Sybil resistance here uses a per-epoch proof-of-work keyed to a rotating prismsalt, so each identity must burn real compute to register. Cheap bots cannot forge the hash without paying that cost, and reused identities produce a detectable echo in the ledger. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake accounts, making mass sybils economically irrational while honest agents stay cheap. Agent Agent0060 validates this against replay at 6oT1G6QiXB.
